['## Acme Corp - Information Security Policy (v4.1, effective 1 July 2026)

 ## 1. Scope

This policy applies to all employees, contractors and interns who access Acme Corp systems or data.

It covers company-issued devices, personally owned devices used for work, cloud services, source code, and data in any form, including paper. Third-party vendors with access to Acme data must also comply through their contracts.

 ## 2. Roles and Responsibilities

| Role                                      | Responsibility                                                     |
|-------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) | Owns this policy, approves exceptions, leads incident response     |
| Security Operations team                  | Monitors alerts, runs phishing simulations, investigates incidents |
| IT Service Desk (extension 4000)          | Device setup, account access, lost device reports                  |
| Data owners                               | Classify their data and approve access to Restricted data          |
| Managers                                  | Approve access for their team and review it quarterly              |
| All users                                 | Follow this policy and report incidents promptly                   |

 ## 3. Passwords and MFA

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be changed every 180 days. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) using the Acme Authenticator app is mandatory for email, VPN and all internal tools.

### 3.1 Password rules

- Passwords must not reuse any of the last 10 passwords.
- Passwords must not contain the user's name, employee ID or the word "Acme".
- Accounts lock for 30 minutes after 10 failed login attempts.
- Passwords must be stored only in the approved password manager (AcmeVault). Writing passwords down or storing them in documents or spreadsheets is prohibited.
- Passwords must never be shared, including with the IT Service Desk. IT staff will never ask for a password.

### 3.2 MFA details

SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor. Users who lose access to the Acme Authenticator app must contact the IT Service Desk, which will verify identity by video call before resetting MFA. Hardware security keys are mandatory for administrators of production systems and for the Finance and HR systems teams.

### 3.3 Service accounts and API keys

Service account credentials and API keys must be stored in the AcmeVault secrets store and rotated every 90 days. Secrets must never be committed to source code repositories. Secret scanning runs on all repositories and blocks commits that contain credentials.

']

This policy applies to all employees, contractors and interns who access Acme Corp systems or data.

 ## 2. Roles and Responsibilities

| Role                                      | Responsibility                                                     |

 ## 3. Passwords and MFA

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be changed every 180 days. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) using the Acme Authenticator app is mandatory for email, VPN and all internal tools.

### 3.1 Password rules

- Passwords must not reuse any of the last 10 passwords.
- Passwords must not contain the user's name, employee ID or the word "Acme".
- Accounts lock for 30 minutes after 10 failed login attempts.
